offerings.title: Explora Journeys
offerings.summary: Suites only, most restaurants and drinks included, no announcements. The best current answer to "I want a ship that feels like a good hotel".

offerings.title: Silversea
offerings.summary: Monaco-based, all-suite ships with a butler for every suite, and an expedition fleet for the polar regions and the Galápagos. Small enough to use the harbours big ships cannot.

offerings.title: Variety Cruises
offerings.summary: Small ports, swim stops, a crew you know by name. Cabins are compact; nobody spends time in them anyway.

offerings.title: Scenic
offerings.summary: Luxury river cruising on the Danube, Rhine, Moselle, Seine, Rhône and Douro, with drinks, excursions and a butler for every suite in the fare.

offerings.title: Seabourn
offerings.summary: Small all-suite ships with a marina at the stern for swimming and water sports; the fare includes drinks and gratuities.

offerings.title: Regent Seven Seas
offerings.summary: All-suite ships whose fare includes shore excursions, drinks and gratuities, and on most sailings the flights.

offerings.title: Ponant
offerings.summary: French small ships and expedition yachts, from the Greek islands to the polar regions.

offerings.title: SeaDream
offerings.summary: SeaDream sailings booked through Cruise24, with the fare confirmed with the line before you commit.

offerings.title: Sea Cloud
offerings.summary: Tall ships under real sail, with a small number of cabins and the sails set by hand.

offerings.title: Star Clippers
offerings.summary: Four-masted clipper ships for the Greek, Turkish and Italian coasts, relaxed and outdoors.

offerings.title: Celestyal
offerings.summary: Greek line, mid-size ships, itineraries built around long port days in the Aegean. Three-, four- and seven-night loops from Athens.

offerings.title: AROYA Cruises
offerings.summary: Winter in the Red Sea from Jeddah, summer in the eastern Mediterranean from Turkish ports. Alcohol-free, family-focused, well organised.

offerings.title: MSC Cruises
offerings.summary: Geneva-based, Italian at heart, the world's largest privately held cruise company. Best for families and anyone who wants a big ship at a fair price. Watch the extras: drinks, Wi‑Fi and service charge add up.

offerings.title: A-ROSA
offerings.summary: German river line, Rhine and Danube plus Rhône and Seine. The only river line with proper family cabins and a children's programme on some boats. All-inclusive drinks in the "Premium" fare.

offerings.title: nicko cruises
offerings.summary: Stuttgart-based, river and small-ship expedition cruises. Quiet, well-fed, German-language on board with English available. Douro and Rhine are the strong programmes.

offerings.title: Amadeus River Cruises
offerings.summary: Lüftner family, Vienna. Classic Danube itineraries from Passau, plus Rhine, Seine and the Dutch waterways at tulip time. The boats are elegant without trying to be hotels.
